loudnessReference.pitchConvention: MIDI note numbers at sounding/concert pitch (C4 = 60)
loudnessReference.measurementRangeMeaning: Recommended representative calibration tessitura; not the full playable range.

instrumentConventions.trumpet: Trumpet in Bb is the canonical/default trumpet; stored pitch ranges are sounding/concert pitch.

inferredReferencePolicy.zeroMeaningAfterInference: No defensible estimate could be produced
inferredReferencePolicy.note: Inferred reference values model the missing library observation; they are not final Symphonic Balance targets.
inferredReferencePolicy.arraySemantics: Array entries are ordered variants/players/section sizes. They must never be averaged or collapsed during inference or curation.
